column2: [19] Operation Guillotine

Following years of brutal struggle, our forces on Kwalasha have finally isolated and trapped the Brain Bug orchestrating the Arachnid hordes on the planet.

A vicious battle still lies ahead but we must seize this opportunity to cut off the head of the monster and bring an end to its reign of terror.

OK you Apes, listen up! I can't say when this war with the Bugs will end -- that's up to Terran Command. But the war on Kwalasha... it ends today, and it's up to us. This is the final showdown.
5th division is providing support. They’ve got penal battalions mixed in with them, so we’ll have to put up with those criminals and deserters on our flank while we push uphill
Intel says the brain bug is holed up in a cave system on top the mountain. Drive up on the right and pry that sonufabitch out into daylight.
Capture it alive, kill every other bug on this hill. You get me?
Once we have broken through the outer ring of hives, we will push north and establish a new base in the abandoned outpost across the river.
Here they come! Bugs bursting out of the ground!
I see this ambush as a positive sign. If the Brain Bug is willing to risk exposing itself in that fashion, the Bugs' situation must be desperate.
Brain bug’s in the bag. Good job, troopers.
You just conquered a planet. Without leadership, any surviving bugs will be no match for us.
Hey, 5th division. Thanks for the backup.
You’re welcome, ma'am. And thank you for pulling our asses out of the fire.
Colonel Hawthorne? What are you doing here?
It’s Private Hawthorne now. 16th Penal Battalion. Command offered me an Other than honorable discharge but I couldn’t sit around doing nothing, not while people were dying – so I re-enlisted.
Good to hear your voice again… private.
You too, ma'am.
Brain bug’s in the bag. Good job, troopers.
You just conquered a planet. Without leadership, any surviving bugs will be no match for us.
Hey, 5th division. Thanks for the backup.
You should know, your former CO, Samuel Hawthorne was among them.
Colonel Hawthorne’s here?

Command gave him the option to retire, instead he took a demotion to keep on fighting. Couldn’t sit idle while the MI was still marching into danger. Private Hawthorne was reported KIA during your ascent.
I could have saved him.
He didn’t need saving. He died with his troops, a hero of the Federation. It’s what he wanted.
The Brain Bug is in the open! Man, that thing is ugly!
You realize this reeks of a trap.
When it comes to the Bugs, colonel, everything reeks. But we're going to be ready for them.
The brain bug has been detected to the north. This time there can be no escape
OK, surround the area, then get in there and finish this.
Remember, the Brain Bug must be captured alive and unharmed. The scientists will be glad to have a fresh specimen, but their investigative methods can be quite... robust.
Flanking division’s getting overwhelmed. 5th division, come in, what’s the situation?
We’re getting chopped up pretty bad here, Colonel.
Roger that. Do you need support?
You know how this works. Every bug on us is one less standing in your way. Get up that hill and finish the job.
What’s you name, officer?
Officers are all dead. We’re all that’s left. We’ll hold them as long as you need. Over and out . . .
Last turret has been deployed.  No way the Bugs are taking back this bit of Kwalasha.
Wavebreaker turrets are being sent down to secure the area we've taken.
Secure the other Wavebreaker deployment locations and we can make this sector Bug proof.
M11 Honor Guard deployed!
Thank you.  It does make for quite a sight, doesn't it.
I'm just glad I'm not going to be the one to have to polish it up afterwards
FedNet is broadcasting the final assault. They'd like some footage of the Honor Guard Marauders on the battlefield.
Aren't they just for parades and ceremonies?
While these carry thinner armor than the production Marauders, the Honor Guard pilots are the cream of the crop. But they do mostly just look good on film.
If they think it's going to help, then we'll see what we can do.  But it can't get in the way of winning this fight
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss.
The fleet is bringing in more supplies as fast as they can.
Supplies have been delivered, more are coming soon.
More supplies have been delivered.
All supply depots have been filled up!
The TAC Fighters have arrived. I hope you like the smell of roasted bugs!
Fleet will commence bombing runs to weaken the final hives. Stay out of the fire zone and time your advance accordingly.
